scope: Sweep allocations reached inside the AC1024 OBJECTS callback while emitting typed base, dimension-body pair, value, and geometry associative dependency records.

source.profile: The base dependency profile has class version 3, status -7, read/attached flags, dependency order -2, present name allocation-retry, body id -9, and a non-null body handle to the paired dimension body. The paired ASSOCDIMDEPENDENCYBODY has handle 0xE902, parent 0xE901, name BOLTHOLE, version-1 body/base/class fields, and one complete 30-bit dependency-body prefix with four decoded values. The value-dependency profile adds class version 0, name VALUE_DEPENDENCY, and a real value 12.5. The geometry profile adds class version 0, enabled state, AcDbAssocSingleEdgePersSubentId, and dependent-on-compound-object state; dependency references and subentity indices remain null/default.

implementation.method: Warm and calibrate each record profile in ASCII and Binary. For the base profile, emit the dependency and linked dimension body in one OBJECTS callback. Inject std::bad_alloc at every reached callback offset; require failed whole-file publication, byte-identical destination sentinel preservation, caller-record preservation, same-codec retry, and fresh DXF typed readback of the dependency/body links and fields plus the value and geometry dependency fields.

validation.ascii: Base dependency + dimension body pair: 12/12; value dependency: 8/8; geometry dependency: 8/8 callback allocation offsets injected. Destination and source records were preserved; same-codec retry and typed readback passed.
validation.binary: Base dependency + dimension body pair: 12/12; value dependency: 7/7; geometry dependency: 7/7 callback allocation offsets injected. Destination and source records were preserved; same-codec retry and typed readback passed.

limitations: Generated serialization and transaction evidence only; no physical producer prevalence or native associative semantics are established.

The DWG prefix bit span and decoded-count metadata used to admit the generated body are not DXF fields; typed DXF readback asserts only serialized body versions/name/owner and the dependency handle link.

The paired dependency/body route closes only its generated body-handle and owner link. It has no actual dimension entity, constraint group, node, value-dependency edge, source-backed profile, or native constraint semantics. Integer values remain outside scope; geometry coverage is limited to a generated default-index SingleEdge profile.
nextAction: Qualify a complete rooted dimension-constraint graph only after admitting a coherent constraint node profile, actual dimension entity, value-dependency edge, group membership, reactor closure, and body ownership; keep the generated pair as transport evidence only.
